title: Prince William Reveals Why Taylor Swift, Travis Kelce's 2024 Photo With Royal Family Almost Didn't Happen
text:
Taylor Swift, Travis Kelce's Photo With Royal Family Almost Didn't Happen

News Photos Videos Shopping Kardashians Couples Influencers Red Carpet Royals TV Scoop News Photos Videos Shopping Kardashians Couples Influencers Red Carpet Royals TV Scoop Prince William Reveals Why Taylor Swift, Travis Kelce's 2024 Photo With Royal Family Almost Didn't Happen
 Prince William revealed the hilarious reason Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's 2024 photo with the royal family—which they used to hard-launch their romance—nearly didn’t happen. 
 By Sasha Wayman Oct 24, 2026 1:31 PM | Updated 14 hours ago Tags Taylor Swift Couples Royals Celebrities Travis Kelce Link Copied Add E! News to Google Watch : Prince William Reveals Why Taylor Swift, Travis Kelce's 2024 Photo With Royal Family Almost Didn't Happen Prince William once had a bone to pick with Taylor Swift ’s lover Travis Kelce .
 After all, the Prince of Wales revealed the iconic 2024 photo where he and his kids Prince George , 13, and Princess Charlotte , 11, posed alongside the Grammy winner and the Kansas City Chiefs tight end almost had a different fate.
 “I was trying to move him out of the photo!” William admitted of Travis during the Oct. 23 episode of The Graham Norton Show . "Travis kept coming back in, and I couldn't work out why he kept coming back in! I was trying to move him out so it was just me and Taylor and the children!"
 William—who also shares son Prince Louis , 8, with Kate Middleton —had taken George and Charlotte to the first night of the “Lover” singer’s eight-night run at London's Wembley Stadium that June. And after the foursome posed for the selfie, Taylor proved she was ready for it when it came to the next step in her and Travis’ relationship.
 read All the Celebs Who've Been the Reason for the Teardrops on Taylor Swift's Guitar Indeed, she used the pic to go Instagram official with her guy on the Chiefs. And while William wished he could have booked the NFL star a getaway car at the time, it’s only because he didn’t realize he was witnessing a pivotal moment in the pair’s love story.
 "I wasn't until recently," he explained. "I hadn't appreciated the significance.”
 Though William couldn’t have known he was part of something bigger than the whole sky in the moment, it didn’t take long before Travis became king of his heart. In fact, the 44-year-old dropped everything to make a surprise appearance on Travis and brother Jason Kelce ’s New Heights podcast last July.
 Instagram/Taylor Swift “Our guest today is the 6’3’’ prince from London, England,” Jason announced in a promotional video shared for the podcast July 3 . “That’s right, the president of the English Football Association, the vice royal patron of the Welsh Rugby Union, The Duke of Cambridge, the Duke of Cornwall, the Lord of the Isles, Prince and Great Steward of Scotland, Earl of Chester and the Prince of Wales.”
 As Travis—who tied the knot with Taylor at Madison Square Garden July 3—laughed along with his brother’s killer introduction, Jason continued, “Please welcome his Royal Highness, Prince William.”
 And William was absolutely enchanted over the welcome.
 “That is quite an intro, guys,” he joked. “Amazing.”
 But that’s just because Jason respects William’s big reputation. As he put it, “We had to do it big for you— had to do it big.”
 Keep reading for more about how Taylor and Travis’ fairytale romance began…
 Fernando Leon/TAS23/Getty Images for TAS Rights Management July 2023: Make the Friendship Bracelets
 Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce 's love story began in July 2023, when the singer's Eras Tour made a stop at Arrowhead Stadium in Kansas City, Mo.
 As a huge Swiftie, the Kansas City Chiefs tight end caught the show with hopes of giving Taylor a friendship bracelet with his number on it . However, he failed to complete the pass due to her pre-show rituals.
 "I was disappointed that she doesn't talk before or after her shows because she has to save her voice for the 44 songs that she sings," Travis shared on the July 26 episode of his  New Heights podcast. "So, I was a little butt-hurt I didn't get to hand her one of the bracelets I made for her."
 JC Olivera/Getty Images Summer 2023: This Is Him Trying
 After publicly recounting his fumble—a move Taylor would later describe as "metal as hell" —Travis decided to shoot his shot and invite the Grammy winner to watch the Chiefs play at Arrowhead Stadium.
 "I threw it out there, I threw the ball in her court," he shared on The Pat McAfee Show . "I told her, you know, 'I've seen you rock the stage in Arrowhead, you might have to come see me rock the stage in Arrowhead and see which one's a little more lit.' So, we'll see what happens in the near future."
 Michael Owens/Getty Images August 2023: Enchanted to Meet You
 Travis was rocking a mustache—which he debuted in August during training camp—when he was first introduced to Taylor .
 As he later noted of the era, "That 'stache and the 87 jersey was pretty iconic there for a little bit, and I had it when I met Taylor for the first time."
 Matt Winkelmeyer/Getty Images for The Recording Academy / David Eulitt/Getty Images September 2023: Sparks Fly
 By early September, a source close to the situation told E! News that Travis and Taylor were " texting and talking here and there ."
 "It's been very low-key," the insider explained, "as he's been in season."
 Cooper Neill/Getty Images September 2023: Cheer Captain
 Accepting Travis' invite, Taylor joined the athlete's mom Donna Kelce at Arrowhead Stadium to watch him and the Chiefs take on the Chicago Bears. After the game, Taylor and Travis were seen packing PDA at a local bar .
 Though folklore had it that it was the couple's first in-person meeting, the "Karma" singer later clarified the two had spent a "significant amount of time" getting to know each other beforehand.
 As Taylor noted, "We would never be psychotic enough to hard launch a first date." 
 Kevin Sabitus/Getty Images October 2023: Team Up
 As an indication that the relationship was heating up, Taylor brought her squad —including friends Blake Lively , Ryan Reynolds , Sophie Turner , Hugh Jackman , Sabrina Carpenter and Antoni Porowski —to watch the Chiefs play against the New York Jets at MetLife Stadium in New Jersey.
 David Eulitt/Getty Images October 2023: It's Nice to Have a Friend
 Another sign that Travis could be The 1 ? Taylor started bonding with Brittany Mahomes —the wife of Travis' BFF and teammate Patrick Mahomes —in and outside of NFL games .
 Gotham/GC Images October 2023: Welcome to New York
 The couple took their romance to TV, making a surprise appearance on the Oct. 14 episode of Saturday Night Live . Their Big Apple takeover also included the after-party for the NBC sketch show and a date night at the Waverly Inn .
 Marcelo Endelli/TAS23/Getty Images for TAS Rights Management November 2023: Karma Is Her Boyfriend
 During a bye week, Travis traveled down to Argentina to catch the South American leg of Taylor's Eras Tour. Not only did the NFL star bond with Taylor's dad , Scott Swift , at the Nov. 11 show in Buenos Aires, but he also got a special shoutout from the stage.
 " Karma is that guy on the Chiefs ," Taylor sang, "coming straight home to me."
 After the show, the Midnights  artist was seen running up to Travis backstage and greeting him with a passionate kiss .
 Buda Mendes/TAS23/Getty Images for TAS Rights Management December 2023: Speak Now
 Taylor addressed the lavender craze surrounding her appearances at Travis' games.
 "I'm going to see him do what he loves, we're showing up for each other, other people are there and we don't care," she told Time . "The opposite of that is you have to go to an extreme amount of effort to make sure no one knows that you're seeing someone."
 Kathryn Riley/Getty Images December 2023: You, Who Charmed Her Dad
 The music superstar turned Travis' Dec. 17 game into a family affair, bringing her dad to cheer on her man .
 Gotham/GC Images January 2024: All the Midnights
 Taylor and Travis spent their first New Year's Eve together, sharing a romantic kiss when the clock struck midnight on Jan. 1.
 Kathryn Riley / Contributor (Getty Images) January 2024: Chosen Family
 Continuing to bond with Travis' family, Taylor hung out with his brother Jason Kelce and sister-in-law Kylie Kelce at the Chiefs' game against the Buffalo Bills.
 Patrick Smith/Getty Images January 2024: Saved by the Perfect Kiss
 Taylor joined Travis on the football field when the Chiefs won the AFC Championship , a victory that cemented the team's spot in the 2024 Super Bowl . The couple shared a celebratory kiss before exchanging the L-word .
 "Tay, I'm gonna enjoy with the guys," he told her. "I love you—so much it's not funny."
 Ezra Shaw/Getty Images February 2024: Super Bowl Champs
 The pair locked lips on the field after Travis led the Kansas City Chiefs to victory on Feb. 11, 2024 in Las Vegas.
 TikTok February 2024: TikTok Official
 Taylor posted footage of Travis on social media for the first time Feb. 12, poking fun at how she took her parents clubbing with the athlete after the Super Bowl.
 Instagram / Taylor Swift June 2024: Instagram Official
 Taylor's first Instagram pic featuring Travis was a selfie of the two with  Prince William and his and wife  Kate Middleton 's eldest kids  Prince George and  Princess Charlotte backstage at the singer's Eras tour show at Wembley Stadium in London.
 Gareth Cattermole/TAS24/Getty Images for TAS Rights Management June 2024: Travis' Eras Tour Stage Debut
 While attending his seventh Eras tour concert, and second show at London's Wembley Stadium, the NFL star joined his girlfriend onstage as a backup performer during her performance of "I Can Do It With a Broken Heart."
 Instagram September 2024: Back in the Game
 Taylor joined Travis for the Chief's first game of the regular 2024-25 season and appeared to re-enact a PDA moment from October 2023 in this photo shared by Chariah Gordon , who is pictured with her boyfriend, Chiefs wide receiver Mecole Hardman .
 Janet Mayer / Splash by Shutterstock September 2024: Wedding Date
 The two attended model  Karen Elson 's wedding to Electric Lady Studios owner Lee Foster in New York City.
 Sarah Stier/Getty Images September 2024: U.S. Open Date
 The next day, the pair attended the men's singles final match at the U.S. Open .
 XNY/Star Max/GC Images October 2024: Double Date
 The two stepped out for a double dinner date with Blake Lively and  Ryan Reynolds in NYC.
 TheStewartofNY/GC Images December 2024: Empire State of Mind
 The pair stepped out for two back-to-back dates in New York City over the last weekend of 2024, matching outfits both times.
 Travis Kelce/Instagram March 2025: Off-Season Adventures
 The pair spent the NFL off-season together, enjoying a snowy vacation to Montana with sportscaster Erin Andrews .
 Travis Kelce/Instagram July 2025: Instagram Hard Launch
 Travis posted his first pics with Taylor on Instagram in July 2025, including an adorable shot of them at dinner—which subtly revealed their phone lockscreen pics of one another.
 New Heights/YouTube August: 2025: Taking Their Romance to New Heights
 Self-described  New Heights  superfan Taylor made her debut on Travis and Jason's podcast in a nearly two-hour-long special episode Aug. 13. In addition to very candidly detailing their life together —in and out of the spotlight—Taylor also revealed her 12th studio album The Life of a Showgirl , set to debut Oct. 3.
 Instagram/KillaTrav August 2025: She'd Marry Him With Paper Rings
 More than two years after Travis' podcast shoutout heard 'round the world, Travis and Taylor announced they are engaged . Making a cheeky reference to her song "So High School." the two captioned the Aug. 26 Instagram post featuring their engagement photos, "Your English teacher and your gym teacher are getting married."
 While Taylor would've married Travis with paper rings, the athlete popped the question with an old mine brilliant cut diamond sparkler he co-designed with Artifex Fine Jewelry's Kindred Lubeck .
 John Shearer/TAS24/Getty Images for TAS Rights Management October 2025: The Life of a Showgirl in Love
 Taylor released The Life of a Showgirl , her 12th studio album that she recorded during the Eras Tour. Songs about her romance with Travis include "The Fate of Ophelia"—which included many Easter eggs about the NFL star—and "Wood," in which she cheekily sang that his " love was the key that opened my thighs .”
 "New Heights of manhood," Taylor continued on the track, referencing the name of Travis' podcast. "I ain't gotta knock on wood."
 Kevin Mazur/Getty Images for iHeartRadio March 2026: iHeartTaylor
 Taylor and Travis made their first award show appearance as a couple at the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards, where she won seven trophies including Pop Album of the Year for The Life of a Showgirl .
 " The Life of a Showgirl was really inspired by the energy that I felt like looking into crowds and seeing you guys every single night," she told fans in the audience. "This album probably also feels very happy and confident and free because that's the way that I get to feel every single day of my life because of my fiancé, who's here tonight."
 Taylor added as a nod to her "The Fate of Ophelia" lyrics, "So, thanks for all the vibes."
 Jason Miller/Getty Images June 2026: In the Knick of Time
 Ahead of their highly anticipated wedding , the couple enjoyed a PDA-filled date night at a New York Knicks vs. Cleveland Cavaliers game in Travis' hometown.
